contract_refs: API: POST /collections/{collection_name}/points/batch - Batch update points (mixed operations)
developer_cognition: 'Batch operations are not promised to be atomic: users must assume partial application and retry (idempotent write design)'

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: batch API → validate_vector_dimensions (early O(n) check before WAL write) → validate_batch_vectors → dimension comparison → return Err on mismatch
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: validate_vector_dimensions 在 batch 操作写入 WAL 前执行 O(n) 维度检查,遇到维度不匹配立即返回错误,阻止任何数据写入。这是 by-design 的早期验证行为,不是原子性违反。

falsification.observed: count=3 (original 3 points), no new points added. Original claim of 'partial write' falsified.

verdicts.rationale: 原 oracle 声称 batch 操作中向量维度错误违反原子性（部分成功部分失败），但实测显示：1) HTTP 400 错误正确返回，操作被完全拒绝；2) count 证伪显示无任何点被写入（维持 3 个原始点）；3) 源码接地发现 validate_vector_dimensions 在 WAL 写入前执行早期维度检查，遇到不匹配立即返回错误，这是 by-design 的验证行为；4) developer_cognition 明确说明 batch 操作不保证原子性。无违规。

contract.explicit_requirement: API contract for batch operations does not guarantee atomicity (developer_cognition)
